fields.description:
Prepare the committed helper and a verified real rehearsal artifact needed by the reclaim window. This story performs no remote ref deletion and never pushes. A6-1 alone refreshes the bundle if `origin/tickets` moved, deletes the identified pins, and publishes the rewrite after all writers are quiesced. Session log 1cb6-d553-6565-49b4 contains the measured facts.

## Context

The remote tag `refs/tags/pre-heal-a118-20260710T005736Z` and host-local tag `refs/tags/pre-a3-remediation` retain pre-rewrite history. An in-repository backup branch or tag would defeat reclamation, so rollback material must be a bundle stored outside every Git worktree and Git directory. The helper must derive live ref OIDs at execution time rather than trust measured counts or hardcoded object IDs.

## Plan

- Add `infra/scripts/prepare_reclaim_backup.py`, a stock-Git CLI that runs only in a clean, unfiltered clone. It accepts the old tickets tip, an off-repo bundle path, a JSON manifest path, and repeatable pin-ref names. Import the landed A6-0c `run_git`, `ref_name`, `is_partial_clone`, and `ReclaimError` helpers from `reclaim_bridge_history.py` so the promisor detection and operator remedy cannot drift.
- Enumerate `git ls-remote --heads --tags origin` at run time, collapse annotated-tag `^{}` lines onto canonical refs, and record every default-clone head/tag with its exact direct and peeled OID. For each commit tip, record one deterministic relationship to the old tip: same, old-tip-is-ancestor, ref-is-ancestor, diverged-with-merge-base, unrelated, or non-commit. This makes every ancestry intersection explicit without hardcoding a ref count.
- Resolve each requested pin by name from the live enumeration or the local clone. Refuse missing/non-commit pins. Create temporary refs beneath a dedicated run-unique `refs/reclaim-backup/<run-id>/` namespace, build the bundle from only those explicit refs, verify it, then remove the namespace in a `finally` path. At startup, enumerate only `refs/reclaim-backup/`, remove stale helper-owned refs left by abnormal termination, and prove a retry uses current requested OIDs. Never remove refs outside that namespace.
- Refuse partial/promisor clones and any bundle or manifest path inside the repository, its Git directory, or another registered worktree. Create parent directories only outside those boundaries and fail rather than overwrite an existing artifact.
- Prove the bundle by restoring it into a throwaway repository and comparing the restored old-tip and pin-tip object IDs exactly. Snapshot the protected source refs before and after and assert that preparation performed no push, delete, or remote mutation.
- Run the helper against a fresh real unfiltered clone and store the rehearsal bundle/manifest outside the repository. Record absolute paths, SHA-256 checksums, sizes, old tip, pin tips, and `git bundle verify` output on this ticket. A6-1 must create a fresh final bundle after quiescence whenever its observed old tip differs from this rehearsal manifest.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] [code-verifiable] A real-repository integration test proves the helper enumerates every live origin head/tag at run time without a hardcoded count. Tier: temporary real Git remotes.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] The manifest collapses each annotated-tag `^{}` line onto its canonical ref while retaining exact direct and peeled OIDs. Tier: temporary real Git remotes.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] The manifest assigns every enumerated commit ref exactly one old-tip relationship. Tier: temporary real Git remotes with same, ancestor, descendant, diverged, and unrelated fixtures.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] The manifest records a non-commit ref without invoking an ancestry operation on that object. Tier: temporary real Git remote with a blob ref.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] A promisor or partial clone exits nonzero before any backup ref or artifact is created. Tier: CLI integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] Partial-clone refusal names the fresh-unfiltered-clone remedy. Tier: CLI integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] A bundle destination inside any registered worktree or Git directory is refused. Tier: CLI integration with real worktrees.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] A manifest destination inside any registered worktree or Git directory is refused. Tier: CLI integration with real worktrees.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] An existing bundle or manifest artifact is never overwritten. Tier: CLI integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] The created bundle exposes a named ref resolving to the exact old-tip SHA. Tier: real Git bundle integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] The created bundle exposes one named ref resolving to each requested pin-tip SHA. Tier: real Git bundle integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] `git bundle verify` succeeds for the completed bundle. Tier: real Git bundle integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] Restoring the bundle into a throwaway repository reproduces the old-tip SHA exactly. Tier: real Git restore integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] Restoring the bundle reproduces every requested pin-tip SHA exactly. Tier: real Git restore integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] A recording Git wrapper observes no push or remote-delete invocation. Tier: CLI integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] Exact origin heads/tags output is byte-identical before and after a successful run. Tier: real Git remote comparison.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] Failed verification removes incomplete bundle/manifest artifacts plus the current run temp-ref namespace. Tier: fault-injected real-repository integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] A retry after abnormal termination removes only stale `refs/reclaim-backup/` refs and succeeds with current requested OIDs. Tier: killed-subprocess integration with real Git refs.
- [ ] [operator-attested] A ticket comment records the real rehearsal bundle absolute path, manifest absolute path, SHA-256 checksums, byte sizes, observed old tip, included pin tips, and successful `git bundle verify` output.
- [ ] [operator-attested] A ticket comment confirms A6-0d changed no remote ref.
- [ ] [operator-attested] A ticket comment requires A6-1 to recreate the final bundle when the quiet-window old tip differs from the rehearsal manifest.

## Verification commands

- `pytest tests/integration/test_prepare_reclaim_backup.py -v`
- `make lint`
- `make typecheck`
- `make test`

## Scope

`infra/scripts/prepare_reclaim_backup.py` and `tests/integration/test_prepare_reclaim_backup.py`. No source-module, configuration, or remote-ref mutation. Scope: M. Depends on closed A6-0c; A6-1 consumes the helper and owns final refresh/deletion/publication.
